ITEM 1 | Yellow-orange rice-like grains with visible flecks of orange and green pieces, loosely mounded in the upper-left of the plate, dry and separate with slight sheen, covering roughly 15% of the plate surface and about 1.5 cm deep | 120
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown breaded or crusted piece of meat with a flaky, crisp, speckled surface and light seasoning flecks, lying across the center-left of the plate, roughly 9 x 5 cm and about 2.5 cm thick, partly under the rice, showing light browning and a moist interior edge | 150
ITEM 3 | Whole green beans, bright to olive green with slight darker streaks, glossy and lightly cooked, tender but holding shape, arranged in a diagonal bundle across the right side of the plate, about 14 cm long and roughly 1 cm thick, with a few small orange bits of carrot among them | 90
